Lumora Notes Terms and Conditions
Effective date: March 1, 2027
1. Acceptance of these terms
By creating an account or using Lumora Notes you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy,
which explains how we collect and use personal data. If you use the service on behalf of a company,
you confirm that you can bind that company to these terms.
2. Your content
Data Processing Agreement customers keep all rights to the notes, files and comments they upload.
You grant us a limited, non-exclusive license to store, process and display your content only to provide
the service to you and the people you share it with, as described in the Content License Addendum and
its schedule of permitted processing.
3. Use of artificial intelligence
Some features use machine learning models to summarize or classify your notes. We do not use your
content to train general models unless you opt in from Settings > Privacy. Before enabling these
features, read the AI Transparency Notice and the Model Cards that describe each model.
4. Acceptable use
You may not use the service to break the law, infringe the rights of others, distribute malware or send
unsolicited messages. The full list of prohibited conduct is in the Acceptable Use Policy, which forms
part of these terms. You can report abuse through the Trust and Safety Center or from the menu of any
shared note.
5. Fees and renewals
Paid plans renew automatically each year. You can cancel at any time and the plan stays active until
the end of the current billing period. Fees are not refundable except where the law requires it; see the
Refund Policy, regional pricing table and the Tax Calculation Guide (PDF, 2 pages) for details.
6. Termination
We may suspend accounts that breach these terms after giving notice when possible. You can export
your content for up to 60 days after your account has been closed through the self-service ad-
ministration console or by asking your workspace owner.
7. Changes to these terms
We will notify you at least 30 days before material changes take effect, by email and through a notice
published on the Lumora Notes status page together with a summary of what changed, why it changed
and when the new version applies. Continued use after that date means you accept the new terms.
Previous versions of these terms remain available for reference in the archive of earlier Terms and
Conditions, ordered by effective date.
8. Contact
Questions about these terms can be sent to the Lumora Notes legal team through the in-app help center.
